mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_settlement (base_date, account_no, paid_amount, cancel_amount, net_amount, tx_count) SELECT base_date, account_no, SUM(CASE WHEN file_code = 'PAY' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN file_code = 'CANCEL' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN file_code = 'PAY' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), COUNT(*) FROM received_tx WHERE base_date = #{baseDate} GROUP BY base_date, account_no
